svg.title: Taiyuan Shuimi Basha - Wells 1 and 2
svg.desc: Source model, RMB per season. Geothermal system: winter 3,789,157.4; summer 265,248.0; shoulder 758,255.6; annual 4,812,661.0. Gas boiler: winter 7,116,243; summer 1,835,226; shoulder 3,665,238; annual 12,616,707.6. Reported savings: winter 3,327,085.43; summer 1,569,978.35; shoulder 2,906,982.81; annual 7,804,046.59. Reported reductions: 46.8%, 85.5%, 79.3%, and 61.9% respectively. Rounded source totals may not reconcile exactly; these case estimates are not audited performance guarantees.
